<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
using namespace std;
#define reg register 
#define ll long long

ll n;
ll ans;

ll ele[18];

int dfs(ll x)
{
    int res, now = 16;
    if (x <= 11) return min(x, 11 - x + 2);
    while(ele[now-1] >= x) now--;
    res = (x / ele[now-1]) * (now - 1) + dfs(x % ele[now-1]);
    if (x < ele[now] - x) return res;
    return min(res, now + dfs(ele[now] - x));
}

int main()
{
    ele[1] = 1;
    for (reg int i = 2 ; i <= 16 ; i ++) ele[i] = ele[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    scanf("%lld", &n);
    printf("%d\n", dfs(n));
    return 0;
}
